auth.error.invalid_credentials: The email address or the password is wrong.
auth.error.invite_required: You need an invitation to register on this instance. Open the link of your invitation.
auth.error.locked: Signing in with this email address failed too often. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
auth.error.password_common: This password is one of the most common ones. Choose another.
auth.error.password_too_short: Use at least {min, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.

auth.error.setup_required: This instance is not set up yet.

auth.error.signup_closed: Registration is closed on this instance. Ask its administrator for an account.

auth.error.wrong_password: This is not your current password.

crash.body: An error kept the app from being shown. Its details are below: you can copy them into a report of the problem. Reloading the page may help.
crash.title: Storycreep stopped working
error.csrf_failed: The server refused the request, because it did not seem to come from this page. Try again.
error.limit_exceeded: {key, select, members {The workspace has as many members as it may have} projects {The workspace has as many projects as it may have} other {The workspace has reached one of its limits}}: {usage, number} of {limit, number}.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection, and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
error.rate_limited_soon: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
error.server: The server could not answer. Try again in a moment.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. The error console has the details.
error_console.copy_failed: The details could not be copied. Select them and copy them yourself.
error_console.description: The errors that happened in this tab since it opened. They stay in this browser and are never sent anywhere: copy their details into a report of a problem.
error_console.empty: No errors have happened in this tab.
error_console.repeated: {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} in a row
error_console.report.heading: Storycreep error report
error_console.report.repeated: Happened {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} in a row
error_console.title: Error console
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account, and we will email it a link that resets its password.
forgot.no_email: This instance sends no email, so it cannot email you a link. Ask an administrator of the instance for a link that resets your password.
forgot.sent: If an account has this email address, we have emailed it a link that resets its password. The link works for an hour.
forgot.title: Reset your password
home.body: This version of Storycreep does not include projects yet.
invite.email_fixed: The invitation is for this address.
invite.error.accepted: This invitation has been accepted already.
invite.error.already_member: You are a member of this workspace already.
invite.error.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the workspace's admins to send it again.
invite.error.mismatch: This invitation is for {invited}, but you are signed in as {email}. Sign out, and sign in with {invited}.
invite.no_token: This link is incomplete. Copy the whole link of the invitation into the address bar.
invite.registered: If this email address had no account, it has one now. If it had one already, it stays as it was: sign in with its password above to accept.
invite.signup_closed: Registration is closed on this instance, so only an account that exists can accept the invitation.
invite.summary: You are invited to join {workspace} as {role}.
invite.title: Invitation
login.title: Sign in
not_found.body: There is no page at this address. It may have moved, or the link that led here may be wrong.
not_found.title: Page not found
reset.done: Your password is changed, and every session of your account is signed out. Sign in with the new password.
reset.no_token: This link is incomplete. Copy the whole link into the address bar, or ask for a new one.
reset.title: Choose a new password
route_error.body: This page could not be shown. The error console has the details, which you can copy into a report of the problem.
route_error.title: Something went wrong
sessions.intro: These are the browsers and devices that your account is signed in on. Sign out of any that you do not recognise, and change your password.
sessions.others_revoked: {count, plural, =0 {No other session was signed in.} one {Signed out of # other session.} other {Signed out of # other sessions.}}
sessions.revoke_others: Sign out of every other session
sessions.title: Sessions
setup.code.hint: The server writes it to its log while setup is pending, as setup_code, such as 7K2M-Q9XD-4RTB-H8VW. With Docker Compose, docker compose logs app shows it.
setup.code.label: Setup code
setup.completed: This instance is set up. Sign in with the email address and the password of the account that you created.
setup.error.code: This is not the setup code of this instance. Copy it from the server's log.
setup.error.slug_taken: Another workspace has the address that this name gives. Choose another name.
setup.intro: This instance is new. Create its first account, which administers the instance, and its first workspace.
setup.owner.hint: This account administers the instance, and owns its first workspace.
setup.owner.title: Your account
setup.signup.closed_hint: Only an administrator adds accounts, and only existing accounts accept invitations.
setup.signup.fixed: The server's configuration, STORYCREEP_SIGNUP, sets who can register: {policy}.
setup.signup.invite_hint: The link of an invitation to a workspace registers an account.
setup.signup.open_hint: Anyone who reaches the instance can register an account.
setup.signup.title: Who can register
setup.smtp.enable: Send email through an SMTP server
setup.smtp.from_hint: The address that the email comes from, alone or with a name, as Storycreep <noreply@example.com>.
setup.smtp.hint: Email sends the links that verify email addresses and reset passwords, and invitations. Without it, an administrator gives out those links as text.
setup.smtp.port_hint: Usually 587 for STARTTLS, or 465 for TLS.
setup.smtp.security_none: None, for a relay on this machine or network
setup.smtp.title: Email
setup.smtp.username_hint: Leave it empty for a server that needs no sign-in.
setup.storage.enable: Store uploaded files in an S3-compatible bucket
setup.storage.hint: Without it, the server stores uploaded images on its own disk.
setup.storage.host_hint: As s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com. Your users' browsers must reach it too.
setup.storage.port_hint: Leave it empty for 443 with TLS, or 80 without.
setup.storage.region_hint: Leave it empty for us-east-1, which most S3-compatible storages take.
setup.storage.title: File storage
setup.taken: Someone completed the setup of this instance first. Sign in with the account that it created.
setup.title: Set up Storycreep
setup.workspace.hint: Where your projects are. You can rename it later.
setup.workspace.label: Workspace name
setup.workspace.title: Workspace
shell.unencrypted.body: This page is served over plain HTTP, so your password and everything else that you send cross the network unencrypted, where others can read them. Installing the app, keeping projects offline, and editing offline need HTTPS too. Ask the administrator of this instance to serve it over HTTPS.
shell.unencrypted.title: This connection is not secure.
signup.closed: Registration is closed on this instance. Ask its administrator for an account.
signup.invite_only: You need an invitation to register on this instance. Open the link of your invitation.
signup.registered: If this email address had no account, it has one now. Sign in to continue.
signup.title: Create an account
tokens.copy_failed: The token could not be copied. Select it, and copy it yourself.
tokens.create_intro: A token lets a program, as a CI job or the Godot addon, act as you in this workspace, with the scopes that you tick, and never beyond your role.
tokens.intro: API tokens let programs, as CI jobs and the Godot addon, read and publish your projects without your password. A token acts in one workspace, or on one of its projects.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.name_hint: What the token is for, as Release pipeline.
tokens.no_project: No project of this workspace is shared with you.
tokens.no_workspace: You are not a member of a workspace yet.
tokens.revoke_body: Programs that use it stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
tokens.scope.export_read: Export the authoring data, which can hold comments and personal data.
tokens.scope.project_read: Read the draft too, and export it.
tokens.scope.project_write: Change the draft. It includes reading it.
tokens.scope.snapshot_read: Read the published releases. A token of a CI job that only pulls releases needs this alone.
tokens.scope.snapshot_write: Publish releases. It includes reading them.
tokens.secret_intro: Copy the token of {name} now, and keep it as you keep a password: it is shown only this once.
tokens.target_hint: A token of the whole workspace acts on every project of it; one of a project acts on that project alone.
tokens.title: API tokens
verify.no_token: This link is incomplete. Copy the whole link into the address bar.
verify.title: Verify your email address
verify_notice.body: Verify your email address, {email}: open the link that we emailed to it.
verify_notice.sent: If the address is not verified yet, we have emailed it a new link.
